s.zh: 巨人只能穿巨人专属衣甲（模组设置“巨人穿普通衣服”已关闭）。
s.en: Giants can only wear giant-exclusive apparel (mod setting "giants wear normal clothes" is off).

s.zh: 火巨人、霜巨人（以后的巨人也一样）能穿任何普通衣服，普通衣服随巨躯一起放大显示。（1.146.0 起巨人专属衣甲已全部移除。）关闭后回到1.29.0的旧规则：巨人只能穿专属衣甲；保存设置后，已穿着的普通衣服会在下次换装时脱下。
s.en: Fire giants and frost giants (and future giants too) can wear any normal clothes, which are drawn scaled up with the giant frame. (Giant-exclusive apparel was all removed in 1.146.0.) When off, it returns to the old 1.29.0 rule: giants can only wear exclusive apparel; after saving settings, normal clothes already worn come off at the next outfit change.

s.zh: 巨人的阶序（风暴＞云＞火＞霜＞双头＞独眼）：殖民地有更高位的巨人“阶序井然”+3、有更低位的“统领众巨”+2，同种巨人里近战或手工最高的“氏族之首”+3，有两个以上巨人时“同族之语”+2；有人本事超过首领时会挑战首领（30天一次）。关闭后这些心情和挑战都不出现（火巨人与霜巨人的“世仇”种族关系不受影响）。
s.en: The giant ordning (storm > cloud > fire > frost > ettin > cyclops): with a higher-ranking giant in the colony, "orderly ordning" +3; with a lower one, "commander of giants" +2; the giant with the highest Melee or Crafting among the same kind is "clan head" +3; with two or more giants, "kindred tongue" +2; someone whose skill surpasses the head will challenge the head (once per 30 days). When off, these moods and challenges don't appear (the fire giant and frost giant "ancient feud" racial relationship is unaffected).

s.zh: （1.34.0）家园地图上有成年的风暴巨人（带“风暴预兆”基因）时，点数≥1000的敌对袭击推迟12小时落地，并提前来信说明派系和方向。与竖琴手预警叠加（两者都触发时推迟时间相加）。
s.en: (1.34.0) When the home map has an adult storm giant (with the "storm omen" gene), hostile raids of ≥1000 points are delayed 12 hours before landing, with a letter in advance about the faction and direction. Stacks with the Harpers' warning (when both trigger, the delays add up).
